name: IDC `anti_pd_1_lung`
what: IDC v24 collection anti_pd_1_lung (TCIA doi:10.7937/tcia.2019.zjjwb9ip), tier 1 of the anomaly harvest: 34 subjects and 34 CT series verified on fetch (DICOM), about 4.2 GB; chest, abdomen, pelvis and whole body
level_truth: the data platform records no level labels from the release; its own automatic level calls, which no radiologist has read, are kept apart under its anomaly_harvest folder

segmentations.masks: the lungs and their nodules: 94 segmentations over 79 of the collection's 571 CT series, in IDC v24; the IDC fetch takes the CT series alone, so they are not on the grid
segmentations.by: BAMF Health, automatic, for IDC's analysis results, 15 of them semi-automatic

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together; the folder holds the 39 collections of IDC's first tier together, 3,499 usable CTs of the 3,600 fetched, and this collection's share of them is not counted here
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

how_to_get: Covered by the data platform's pooled IDC route (idc_tier1), which fetches all 39 tier-1 collections, 3,600 series, into its idc folder in one resumable job; this collection alone is that route's manifest idc_tier1.csv filtered on its first column to anti_pd_1_lung, submitted with spinesurg-ct-nnunet's slurm/acquisition_fetch.sh idc while no other fetch of the idc folder runs, since every IDC entry shares its fetch folder; the check is the count of its distinct series in idc/fetch/verified.jsonl, 34.

The route as the manifest prints it: python3 data/reproduce/reacquire/reacquire.py --grid idc_anti_pd_1_lung; on the grid, from ~/spinesurg-ct-nnunet/data_platform/reacquire, sbatch -D "$PWD" --export=ALL,IDS="idc_anti_pd_1_lung",MODE=--run reacquire.sbatch, as a Slurm job on the owner's word.
